info.name: Adobe Captivate Prime API (Learning Manager) Account Catalogs API

params.name: page[offset]
params.description: The offset for pagination (number of records to skip)

params.name: page[limit]
params.description: Maximum number of records to return per page (max 10)

params.name: include
params.description: Comma-separated list of related resources to include. Valid values: learningObjects

items.docs: Retrieves a paginated list of catalogs available to the authenticated user. Catalogs organize learning objects and control visibility.

params.name: catalogId
params.description: The unique identifier of the catalog

params.name: include
params.description: Comma-separated list of related resources to include

items.docs: Retrieves a single catalog by its ID.
